sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The architect role is named and prompted, but the engine never runs it. The role is in internal/roles/roles.go:37, its prompt is internal/roles/prompts/architect.md, and it is read-only (internal/engine/perm.go:39). The engine's role loops cover only implementer, reviewer and gate (internal/engine/engine.go:160-166; internal/daemon/runs.go:210). rg finds no architect round in internal/engine. A size L slice therefore gets no architect review today.
Decided 2026-10-20 (record 123, slice.architect-order): the architect follows the slicer contract. docs/design.md:191-193 says the architect runs alongside the reviewer. The slicer contract (`slicer ai relay`, the orchestrator steps) says it runs after accepted findings and before the gate. The contract also says the architect is optional and the owner decides.
docs/design.md:191-193 is to be corrected in this slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/engine/runner.go:15-19 (role names block): add RoleArchitect = "architect" (proposed name).
- internal/engine/states.go:198-203 (checks choose review or gate): the architect step goes between the fix round and the gate, as record 123 decides (contract order).
- internal/engine/states.go:219-231 (review): the reviewer, and the architect if the lineup has one (order: record 123).
- internal/engine/states.go:239-250 (gate): add the architect report to the gate brief (latestReport at states.go:208).
- internal/engine/engine.go:160-166 (New): implementer and reviewer are required. The architect stays optional. No change expected.
- internal/engine/engine.go:231-245 (advance switch): only if a new state is chosen (Open).
- internal/engine/round.go:142 (runRound): reused. No change expected.
- internal/engine/brief.go:38 (BuildBrief): fills the architect prompt, via roles.Prompt (internal/roles/roles.go:44). Check the placeholders (slice_id, worktree, temp_dir, report_path).
- internal/engine/report.go:37-84 (CheckReport): add an architect branch (shape is Open).
- internal/engine/perm.go:39,45: already read-only. Add a test only.
- internal/daemon/runs.go:210-231: the plan loop adds RoleArchitect when the recommendation has an architect row (slicercli RoleChoice, internal/slicercli/types.go:160-163).
- internal/slicercli/write.go:91-94: passes --split already. No change expected.
- internal/roles/roles.go:37 and internal/roles/prompts/architect.md: no change expected.
- Tests: internal/engine/architect_test.go (new); internal/daemon/runs_test.go (near :93).
- Docs: docs/design.md:191-193 (review bullet: the architect runs after accepted findings, before the gate, record 123). docs/state.md only if a new state is added.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestArchitectRunsOnlyWhenTheLineupHasOne: with no architect entry there is no architect round, and the role list is the same as today (fakeRunner.roles(), internal/engine/harness_test.go:99).
- TestArchitectRunsAfterTheFixRoundAndBeforeTheGate: role order is implementer, reviewer, implementer fix, architect, gate (record 123: the architect runs after accepted findings, before the gate).
- TestArchitectIsReadOnlyAndFingerprinted: its request has ReadOnly true, and a tree change stops the slice.
- TestArchitectFindingsGoBackToTheImplementer: a finding from the architect starts a fix round (the report format is Open).
- TestArchitectShapeErrorPausesAndRetryResumesIt: a bad report pauses with PendingShape, and retry runs the architect again (pattern: internal/engine/pause_test.go:130).
- TestPlanAddsTheArchitectRowOnlyWhenRecommended: RunPlan.Lineup has "architect" only when the recommendation has that row (pattern: internal/daemon/runs_test.go:93).
- TestArchitectRoundIsALedgerStepUnderTheOrchestrator: pattern of internal/engine/engine_test.go:172.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Decided: record 123 (slice.architect-order): the architect runs after accepted findings and before the gate (slicer contract). The report shape below is still to be settled in this slice.
2. Write the failing tests first in internal/engine/architect_test.go (new) and the plan test in internal/daemon/runs_test.go.
3. Add RoleArchitect in internal/engine/runner.go:15-19.
4. internal/daemon/runs.go:210: add RoleArchitect to the plan loop. Plan it only when rec.Roles has an architect choice.
5. internal/engine/states.go:219-231: run the architect as round{role: RoleArchitect, ...} after accepted findings and before the gate (record 123).
6. Add the architect step on the fix-round path (states.go:198-203) before the gate.
7. internal/engine/report.go:37-84: add an architect branch to CheckReport. Its sections come from internal/roles/prompts/architect.md (the Report section). The shape is Open.
8. internal/engine/brief.go:38: BuildBrief fills the architect prompt. Check the placeholders.
9. internal/engine/states.go:239-250: the gate brief includes the architect report (latestReport, states.go:208).
10. internal/engine/perm.go:39 needs no change. Add a test that the architect request has ReadOnly true.
11. Update docs/design.md:191-193 to the contract order (record 123). Update docs/state.md only if a state is added.
12. Run the checks in Check.md.
Open:
- Architect report shape: CheckReport has no architect branch (report.go:37-84).
- Whether ork checks the size itself. The item says size L only, but the matrix row is the only size gate today, and the contract leaves the architect to the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon
- go test -race -count=1 -run Architect ./internal/engine
- go test -race -count=1 -run RunPlan ./internal/daemon
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .   (expect no output)
- slicer check
- adj lint
- A slice with no architect row runs exactly the old role list (the test in Failing-tests.md).
- Tests use fakeRunner only. No live vendor call.
